item.title: From Jolene to Jonah: How pop culture influences New Zealand baby names
item.description: While parents may think deeply about what to call their offspring, name trends over the decades reveal the truth: we are deeply impacted by the names around us. The Spinoff digs into the data. Each January, the Department of Internal Affairs releases the top 100 names given to baby boys and girls in New Zealand the year prior. item.description: How kids hack tired parents with PowerPoint presentations to get what they want.
